newton.note: Hardcoded per-sample arguments to MnaCircuitEngine::processSample() inside CompressorCircuit::processSample(); not runtime-configurable. Recorded here so a change to those literals is a visible, reviewable diff against this file rather than a silent behavior change.

default.note: CompressorCircuit exposes no setControls()/knob API today (see include/guitardsp/circuit/CompressorCircuit.h) -- threshold/ratio/attack/release are fixed by the LDR optocoupler network, not user parameters. Only one variant exists; there is no 'mid'/'full' pair to generate.
